description: This file defines the 'DCountA' class, which implements the database function DCOUNTA for spreadsheet calculations. It counts non-blank cells in a database column matching specified criteria.

classes.name: DCountA
classes.description: Implements the DCOUNTA database function for counting non-blank matching cells.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the number of non-blank cells in a database column that meet specified criteria.
